_about: Tables whose RLS policies reference a phrase gate (team_pass_ok / gr_pass_ok / fin_pass_ok). Consumed ONLY by tests/team_phrase_affordance.test.js, which runs in CI where there is no database. Everything a browser can measure live it should measure live — admin.js reads cobi_rls_gates() at load precisely because a carried list goes stale silently.
_why_a_snapshot_is_acceptable_here: This list is a TRIPWIRE, not an authority. Its failure mode is UNDER-reporting: a newly gated table missing here means the guard misses one tab, which is the same coverage we had before the guard existed. It can never produce a FALSE claim that something is protected, because nothing reads it for that purpose.
_measured: 2026-08-28, live, via the Supabase MCP. The three cpl_funding_* tables left this list when curating funding was narrowed to is_allowed_reviewer() alone (PR #1372); budget_funding stays, so the tab is still phrase-touching.
_refresh_with: select tablename, bool_or(cmd='SELECT' and coalesce(qual,'') ilike '%\_pass\_ok%') as gates_read from pg_policies where schemaname='public' group by tablename having bool_or(coalesce(qual,'')||coalesce(with_check,'') ilike '%\_pass\_ok%') order by tablename;
_note_gates_read: gates_read=true means the SELECT policy itself requires the phrase, so without it the tab renders EMPTY rather than merely read-only. Those are the ones where a missing affordance reads as a broken tab.
